verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents per-institution status, outage or degradation signals, or an error-code taxonomy that separates institution-side failures from integration-side failures. The nearby items are adjacent only: Item-change webhooks, Dashboard MCP tools for debugging Items, and SDK try/catch error handling. None of them is the institution-health capability the story asks for.

support.subject: As an ops lead, per-institution health is visible — documented institution statuses, outage or degradation signals, and error codes that distinguish a bank problem from my problem
